subject: prd/feature-draft
statement: Settle concurrent editing of one draft by several sessions in the technical design (Q9, Q10).
intent: Record the approved mitigation for this exact requirement-ledger risk.
rationale: The operator and several agent sessions may work on the same draft. An edit silently overwritten would corrupt the draft's history; whether edits merge or conflict is a design choice.
fit_criterion: The technical design names the concurrency rule, and two fixture sessions editing one draft at once either both keep their edits or one is refused naming the conflict; no edit is lost silently.
